desc: See magic in every bowl of General Mills St Patricks Day Lucky Charms Gluten Free Cereal with Marshmallows. This limited edition breakfast cereal has green clovers that turn cereal milk magically green! Just pour yourself a bowl, add milk and watch the color change before your eyes. Celebrate the magic of Saint Patrick with this special whole grain cereal with Lucky's magical marshmallows. Share this box on your breakfast table, or think like a leprechaun to bring unexpected magic to the holiday. String together the green clovers, pots of gold and golden coin marshmallows to create St Patricks Day decorations, toss a handful over sundaes as ice cream toppings, or use the Lucky Charms marshmallows to decorate a St Patricks Day cake. Who knows what fun you'll think up when you follow Lucky's trail? This toasted oat cereal provides 19 grams of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily), as well as 12 vitamins and minerals. The kids cereal is also a good source of calcium and vitamin D. This 18.6 ounce box makes it easy to enjoy breakfast together. Whether you're looking for a breakfast food or fun ingredients for marshmallow cereal bars, General Mills cereals spread goodness from tots to grown ups.
features:
Features

St. Patrick's Day Limited Edition
Features special green clover marshmallows that color your milk green.

Made with Whole Grain Oats
Each serving includes 19 grams of whole grain, supporting a balanced diet.

Fortified with 12 Essential Vitamins and Minerals
Including calcium, vitamin D, iron, zinc, and B vitamins.

Gluten-Free
Safe for individuals with gluten sensitivities or celiac concerns.

Classic Lucky Charms Taste
Combines iconic cereal pieces with magically delicious marshmallows.

Family-Size Box
Offers more servings—great for families or sharing. 

Benefits

Festive Fun for All Ages
Turns breakfast into a holiday celebration with green milk and themed shapes.

Boosts Daily Nutrition
Provides a good source of calcium and vitamin D, which support strong bones and teeth.

Supports Whole Grain Intake
Helps meet daily whole grain goals in a fun, tasty way.

Kid-Approved
Visually engaging and sweet, making it easier to get kids excited about breakfast.

Easy to Serve
Just add milk—ready in seconds with no prep time.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Whole Grain Corn, Corn Syrup, Modified Corn Starch, Corn Starch, Salt, Dextrose, Gelatin, Trisodium Phosphate, Yellow 5 & 6, Blue 1, Natural and Artificial Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
